summary: Iteration 6 - Expo SDK 54 -> 57 frontend regression on web preview (390x844 mobile viewport). Backend was explicitly out of scope and NOT retested per request. All 9 requested flows pass cleanly with no SDK-57 regressions. (1) Public landing (unauth, localStorage cleared): renders 'Sound Healing Greece' banner, 'Γνώρισε τη σχολή και τα 4 Levels' with 4 Level cards (Τα θεμέλια, Εμβάθυνση, Ομαδικά Sound Baths, Επαγγελματική ανάπτυξη) + Εκπαιδευτικά grid; no red screen. (2) Login as uitest_167043@test.gr/TestPass12345 -> lands on /profile; renders Test Student card with LevelRing SVG (2 svg elements), L1-L4 progress bars, L1 10-star row, and stats row (Ώρες / Συνεδρίες / Άτομα / Αξιολογήσεις) all present. (3) Login as admin@soundhealing.gr/temple2026 -> lands on /admin SCHOOL WORKSPACE with all section tabs loaded (Επισκόπηση, Μέλη, Ημερολόγιο, Φωτογραφίες, Περιεχόμενο, Φόρμες, Τμήματα, Εγγραφές, Παρουσίες, Πρόοδος, Ιστορικό, Αξιολογήσεις) + 'Αιτήσεις εγγραφής' sub-headings. (4) All 5 bottom tabs navigate: Home (/), Ηχοθεραπεία (/sanctuary), Εκπαιδευτικά (/academy), Εκδηλώσεις (/journey), Profile (/profile). hrefs confirmed from DOM. (5) Practice logging form: /practice route renders without crash; this student (no active cohort enrollment) correctly sees the gated message 'Χρειάζεται ενεργή εγγραφή από τη σχολή για νέα εκπαιδευτική πρακτική' + 'Παλαιότερες καταγραφές' button. This is intentional business gating, NOT an SDK-57 regression. The /sanctuary CTA 'Καταγραφή πρακτικής' correctly deep-links to /practice. (6) Public /feedback/bogus-token-xyz -> graceful 'Link expired - This feedback link is invalid or expired' card, no crash, no auth required. (7) Admin workspace sections (content/cohorts/enrollments and more) all load without crash. (8) Notifications bell: absent on unauth / and /login (verified via querySelector for [aria-label*='Ειδοποι'] / [data-testid*='notification'] -> none); visible on /profile and /admin. (9) Session persistence: after reload on /profile the user stays authenticated (url stays /profile, Ώρες/Αποσύνδεση still rendered). Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. Known pre-existing non-fatal web-only warnings reproduced (NOT regressions, excluded per task note): 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style deprecation, 'Received false for a non-boolean attribute accessible' from SoundSpiral.tsx. One additional web warning observed: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' -- fires on /wellness 404 fallback asset loader -- minor, non-blocking.

issues: No testID/data-testid on interactive elements (email/password inputs, Σύνδεση button, Google sign-in button, bottom-tab items, Καταγραφή πρακτικής CTA, notifications bell). Automation currently relies on Greek-text matching which is brittle. Carried over from iteration_3/4/5.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props still deprecated under react-native-web 0.21 / RN 0.86 - migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to the unified 'boxShadow' prop. Fires on /, /login, /profile, /admin. Carried over, pre-existing.

SoundSpiral.tsx:32 passes accessible={false} to <Svg>; react-native-web forwards it as the DOM attribute `accessible="false"` and React logs a non-boolean attribute error. Pre-existing (noted iter 3/4/5), still a dev-only Console Error -- not a runtime crash. Reference: frontend/src/components/icons/SoundSpiral.tsx:32

'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' - likely surfaces from an <Image style={{resizeMode: ...}} /> usage. Non-fatal web-only warning but should be migrated to <Image resizeMode='...' />. Reference: search frontend/**/*.tsx for 'resizeMode' inside style objects.

action_items: No functional fixes required - SDK 54 -> 57 upgrade regression is CLEAN. Ship it.

(Non-blocking) Add testID attributes on: email/password TextInput, 'Σύνδεση' button, 'Σύνδεση με Google' button, bottom-tab Pressables, 'Καταγραφή πρακτικής' CTA, notifications bell, and admin section tabs.
(Non-blocking) Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props to 'boxShadow'/'textShadow' across frontend/**/*.tsx.

(Non-blocking) In frontend/src/components/icons/SoundSpiral.tsx:32, drop `accessible={false}` or replace with `aria-hidden` for web (RN still accepts the omission) - this will silence the recurring Console Error.
(Non-blocking) Migrate <Image style={{resizeMode: ...}} /> occurrences to <Image resizeMode='...' /> props.

(Deferred confirmation) /practice form input layout is gated by enrollment; user uitest_167043@test.gr has 0 enrollments, so inputs do not render. Confirm with an enrolled student if a deeper form-field regression test is desired, otherwise the /practice page itself renders cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: package.json pins all expected SDK-57 targets: expo ^57.0.0, react 19.2.3, react-native 0.86.3, reanimated 4.5.1, worklets 0.10.1, gesture-handler ~2.32.0, screens ~4.26.0, safe-area ~5.7.0, svg 15.15.4, expo-router ~57.0.24, typescript ~6.0.3, @types/react ~19.2.4 - matches the stated upgrade matrix.

app.json is cleaned of 'newArchEnabled' and 'edgeToEdgeEnabled' as noted; plugins list still includes expo-router/expo-splash-screen/expo-font/expo-image/expo-secure-store/expo-sharing/expo-status-bar/expo-web-browser - all valid under SDK 57.

Expo dev server started cleanly after upgrade and web-bundles successfully (Web Bundled 11113ms, 1473 modules). The electron/React Native DevTools 'running as root' message in supervisor logs is a cosmetic warning (DevTools UI only, not the bundler) and does NOT affect preview rendering.

AuthGate in app/_layout.tsx:63 correctly routes unauth users to the PublicExperience / AuthScreen tree and authed users to Shell(Wellness) with bottom tabs. Session persistence survives a hard reload (AsyncStorage/SecureStore token read on mount).
/feedback/[token] gracefully degrades to a 'Link expired' card on invalid tokens (verified with bogus-token-xyz -> backend returns 404, UI shows copy).

success_rate.frontend: 100% - 9/9 regression checks pass; 3 pre-existing non-fatal web warnings carried over + 1 new (resizeMode) web warning noted
